hero_eyebrow: Every gift, tracked to a program
hero_heading: Fund a child's food, education, and future.
hero_lead: 100% volunteer-run means your donation goes to work immediately. Choose an amount and frequency below. No account required.
ways_heading: Choose the method that works for you
way_1_text: Our preferred method: secure, instant, and you'll receive an immediate email receipt for your records.
way_2_text: Made payable to "Baal Dan Charities." Contact us for our current mailing address.
way_3_text: Available for larger gifts upon request. Reach out and we'll send wire instructions.
ways_footnote: Baal Dan holds 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status (Federal Tax ID 20-4658983). Donations are tax-deductible, and a formal receipt is provided for gifts over $250. Prefer to fund overhead directly, or offer pro bono professional services instead? Contact us. We'd love to talk.
matching_lede: Many employers match charitable gifts dollar-for-dollar (or more). Check if yours does.
matching_companies_intro: Companies that have matched Baal Dan gifts before include:
faq_1_a: Your donation supports orphanages, food and education programs, and can also sponsor a specific child's education. Because Baal Dan is entirely volunteer-run, nearly 100% of what you give goes directly to feeding and educating children in need.
faq_2_a: Yes. Baal Dan Charities is a 501(c)(3) public charity (Federal Tax ID 20-4658983). You'll receive a formal receipt for any gift over $250.
faq_3_q: Can I give monthly instead of one-time?
faq_3_a: Absolutely. We encourage it. Monthly gifts give our grantee partners the stability to plan food and education programs year-round. Toggle "Monthly" above to get started.
faq_4_a: Many companies match employee gifts, including Microsoft (via MSGive), AT&T, Esurance, Wells Fargo, Tellabs, ING, Liberty Mutual and eBay. Use the search box above or check with your HR department.
faq_5_q: Can I donate by check or wire instead of online?
faq_5_a: Yes. Checks and money orders can be made payable to "Baal Dan Charities," and bank wires are available for larger gifts. Contact us for details.
